company.name: Carpool Arabia
company.shortDescription: Carpool Arabia is an affordable and convenient transportation network for the Middle East and Africa region.
company.description:
Carpool Arabia is an affordable and convenient transportation network. Their vision is to build the smartest carpooling solution for urban commuters. As you might suspect they connect drivers with empty seats to passengers looking for a ride. Carpool Arabia is a regular idea made sustainable by reducing the number of cars on the road, thus making the world a better place to live.

They help people to find a commuting buddy to ease their daily transportation to the office. With Carpool Arabia mobile app you can easily find a driver that can pick you up at home and drop you at work. Their machine-learning app always finds the best pool of drivers called "buddies" to give you a ride. As a driver, you can accept or decline the ride anonymously from your carpooling buddy. Drivers receive ride request only if the detour is less than 15 minutes. Carpool Arabia creates local daily heroes and helps them to find the perfect commuting buddy.
